headline: Approved resolutions appropriating funds for North River Road/Bicentennial Drive Roundabout, ACERT, Opioid Litigation Settlement Trust, and other CIP items.
summary: The Committee on Finance voted to waive reading of resolutions by titles only and then voted that the resolutions ought to pass and be enrolled. These resolutions covered multiple Community Improvement Program amendments, including funding for the North River Road/Bicentennial Drive Roundabout, Highway Safety Grant Program, ACERT, School Based Dental Program, Opioid Litigation Settlement Trust, ARPA programs, the Aged and Infirmed Shelter Project, 1269 Café Operations, Manchester Fire Department Squad 1, and the Community Response Unit. The committee also voted to approve budget authorizations subject to final adoption of the related resolutions.
decisions: Approved a series of resolutions amending various Community Improvement Program budgets, including $2,470,500 for the North River Road/Bicentennial Drive Roundabout (CMAQ), $101,734.90 for the FY27 Highway Safety Grant Program, $150,000 for ACERT, $14,000 for the School Based Dental Program, $106,395.33 for the Opioid Litigation Settlement Trust, and other listed amounts; the resolutions were voted to pass and be enrolled.
Approved the listed Budget Authorizations, subject to final adoption of the related resolutions.

decision_evidence.quote: On motion of Alderman O’Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Burkush, it was voted that the Resolutions ought to pass and be Enrolled.
On motion of Alderman Dexter, duly seconded by Alderman O’Neil, it was that the Budget Authorizations be approved subject to final adoption of related Resolutions.

Mayor Ruais called the meeting to order.   
 
The Clerk called the roll.
